interpretation: The correctness defect on unchanged Check is fixed. A local CPU sample placed most compiler-thread samples within WasmKit lazy function translation, but it was a Debug simulator sample and is not a user-device speed claim. One simulator sample per revision cannot establish a cold compiler speedup; the short cache-hit times are not compiler throughput. Release-mode physical-device A/B/C measurements remain required.
